Compress Video Online

Shrink video for sending or uploading. Free, no sign-up, your file stays on your device.

  • Free, no sign-up
  • Processed on your device
  • No watermark

About this tool

Choose the output resolution, and the video is played in the browser and recorded again at a lower resolution and bitrate. It runs for the length of the video (a 2-minute video takes about 2 minutes), so keep the tab open on screen. It suits short videos you need to send in chat or upload to a form. For long videos, an app on your device will be faster.

How to use it

  1. Choose a file

    Drag a file into the box above or click to pick one from your device.

  2. Adjust the options

    Choose the format or quality, then press the process button.

  3. Download the result

    Save the files one by one or all at once in a ZIP.

When this tool is useful

Shrink a video so it can be sent in chat, uploaded to a form, or stored more efficiently without extra apps.

Tips and common mistakes

  • 480p is usually enough for viewing on a phone screen; use 360p or 240p when size matters much more.
  • Turning off the sound saves a little more size.
  • Processing runs for the length of the video; do not close the tab.
  • If the video is already efficient, Ubahin keeps the original file and tells you.

Frequently asked questions

Why does it take long?
The browser re-records the video at normal playback speed. That is how the file avoids being sent to a server.
Why did the result not get smaller?
If the video is already very efficient, the original is kept and you get a note. Try a smaller resolution.
Does the screen have to stay on?
Yes. Browsers slow down tabs that are not visible, so the result can stutter. Keep the tab active until it finishes.
Is my file uploaded to a server?
No. The conversion runs in your browser, so the file stays on your device. Only program components (such as the PDF library) are downloaded from this site; for HEIC and MP3 one extra component is also loaded from jsDelivr. Your file is not sent along.
What is the file size limit?
Ubahin allows 200 MB per file, but the real limit depends on your device memory. Very large files can make the browser slow or stop.
Is it free? Do I need to sign up?
Free, with no account. There is no watermark on the results.
